program:
PARAMS = {
    "Ib":    (25e-6, 12e-6, 50e-6),   # total bias-branch current at mid vctrl (tt)
    "K":     (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),         # stage / bias mirror ratio
    "gmid":  (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),       # gm/Id of all mirror/starving devices
    "Lm":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),        # L of mirror/starving devices
    "fmin":  (0.2, 0.1, 0.35),        # fraction of Ib carried by the bleed resistor
    "Wn":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),         # ring inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Wb":    (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),         # buffer NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    Ib, K, gmid, Lm = p["Ib"], p["K"], p["gmid"], p["Lm"]
    Imin = p["fmin"] * Ib
    Ictl = Ib - Imin

    # --- V-to-I: Mctl (gate vctrl) + source degeneration Rdeg
    vs = 0.3
    for _ in range(3):
        mctl = lut.size("n", gmid, Lm, Ictl, vds=0.5, vsb=vs)
        vs = max(0.05, vmid - mctl.vgs)
    Rdeg = vs / Ictl

    # --- bias mirrors
    mp0 = lut.size("p", gmid, Lm, Ib, vds=0.9)        # PMOS diode (pb)
    Rmin = max(1e3, (VDD - mp0.vgs) / Imin)           # bleed: guarantees minimum current
    mp1 = lut.size("p", gmid, Lm, Ib, vds=0.9)        # copy to NMOS diode
    mn1 = lut.size("n", gmid, Lm, Ib, vds=0.6)        # NMOS diode (nb)
    Is = K * Ib
    mps = lut.size("p", gmid, Lm, Is, vds=0.4)        # stage top starving
    mns = lut.size("n", gmid, Lm, Is, vds=0.4)        # stage bottom starving

    Wn = p["Wn"]; Wp = 2 * Wn; Li = 0.15
    Wbn = p["Wb"]; Wbp = 2 * Wbn

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    # bias
    n.dev("Mctl", "pb", "vctrl", "sdeg", "vss", mctl)
    n.R("Rdeg", "sdeg", "vss", Rdeg)
    n.R("Rmin", "pb", "vss", Rmin)
    n.dev("Mp0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("Mp1", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp1)
    n.dev("Mn1", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mn1)

    # 3-stage current-starved ring: r1 -> r2 -> r3 -> r1
    N = 3
    nodes = ["r1", "r2", "r3"]
    for i in range(N):
        a = nodes[i]; y = nodes[(i + 1) % N]
        n.dev(f"MPS{i}", f"tp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
        n.M(f"MPI{i}", y, a, f"tp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Li)
        n.M(f"MNI{i}", y, a, f"bn{i}", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Li)
        n.dev(f"MNS{i}", f"bn{i}", "nb", "vss", "vss", mns)

    # output buffer from r3 (vout in phase with r2); kick coupling cap
    n.M("MBP", "vout", "r3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wbp, Li)
    n.M("MBN", "vout", "r3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbn, Li)
    Ck = 3e-15
    n.C("Ck", "vout", "r2", Ck)

    # --- predictions
    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Li, 0.9, 0.9); opp = lut.op("p", Wp, Li, 0.9, 0.9)
    obn = lut.op("n", Wbn, Li, 0.9, 0.9); obp = lut.op("p", Wbp, Li, 0.9, 0.9)
    Cg = on["cgg"] + opp["cgg"]
    Cd = 0.5 * Cg + 2e-15                     # drain junction + wiring estimate
    Cn = Cg + Cd + (obn["cgg"] + obp["cgg"]) / N + Ck / N
    eta = 0.6                                 # current not constant during transition
    def f_at(I):
        return eta * I / (N * Cn * VDD)
    f_mid = f_at(Is)
    # low/high vctrl currents (degenerated V-I, linear approx)
    I_lo = K * (Imin + max(0.0, (vlo - mctl.vgs - 0.02)) / Rdeg)
    I_hi = K * (Imin + (vhi - (mctl.vgs + 0.03)) / Rdeg)
    f_lo, f_hi = f_at(max(I_lo, K * Imin)), f_at(I_hi)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 20e-15)
    p_ring = N * Cn * VDD**2 * f_mid
    p_buf = (CL + Ck + 5e-15) * VDD**2 * f_mid * 1.3
    power = 2 * Ib * VDD + p_ring + p_buf
    return n, {
        "f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
        "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
        "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
        "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
        "swing": 0.95 * VDD,
        "power": power,
    }
